description: "Faith and Unfaith: A Novel" by Duchess is a work of fiction likely written in the late 19th century. The story begins with the solemn death of Reginald Branscombe, the fifth Earl of Sartoris, and depicts the emotional turmoil faced by his grieving brother, Arthur.
